citation: State of Delhi v. Mukesh Kumar (2017) 5 SCC 789
reasoning_summary: Conviction under IPC 420 and 120B upheld. Forged property documents proven by expert testimony. Bank records showed money trail to accused. Conspiracy established through phone records showing coordination between co-accused.

facts_established.actus_reus: Accused obtained property through forged documents
facts_established.mens_rea: Knowledge of forgery proven, deliberate deception
